claims.text: The current static LGL FP32 QM9 path completes under strict deterministic CUDA controls on the recorded RTX PRO 6000 without fallback.
claims.permitted_inference: operator support for the exact recorded source, configuration, and environment
claims.falsifier: An unsupported deterministic operator, warning-only downgrade, or seeded fallback
claims.uncertainty: Other architectures, dtypes, hardware, drivers, and distributed execution are untested
claims.next_action: Retain strict mode for matched architecture comparisons

claims.text: Five fresh 500-update strict CUDA processes produced identical validation MAE and one canonical final-state hash.
claims.permitted_inference: same-seed bitwise repeatability for the exact recorded lane
claims.falsifier: Nonzero metric span or more than one final-state hash
claims.uncertainty: One seed and one random-row split do not estimate multi-seed accuracy variance
claims.next_action: Use this lane as the deterministic basis for bounded matched comparisons

claims.text: The registered 0.005 eV same-seed noise threshold passes with measured validation-MAE span and sample standard deviation both equal to zero.
claims.permitted_inference: descriptive runtime noise result for this exact lane
claims.uncertainty: The threshold is a decision rule, not a universal statistical guarantee
claims.next_action: Do not transfer the zero-noise conclusion across configurations without measurement

claims.text: Gradient clipping remains active on 456 of 500 updates in every recorded process.
claims.permitted_inference: diagnostic evidence of persistent high clipping frequency
claims.falsifier: Any raw result reports a different clipping count or denominator
claims.uncertainty: This does not establish clipping as the cause of the accuracy gap
claims.next_action: Test an opt-in receiver-degree normalization with clipping and validation gates
